title: Finish-Recording Error Feedback
requirements: Add user-facing error state to ListViewModel: a non-fatal error banner visibility flag `errorBanner: String?` and a support message string

Wrap moveItem and store.append calls in finishRecording with a do/catch that catches the specific Error; on failure, set errorBanner to "Audio saved to ~/Documents, entry could not be saved: <errorDescription>" — do not swallow with a bare catch
Add an error banner / toast to ContentView that renders errorBanner conditionally, with a Dismiss button that sets errorBanner = nil
Keep the moved-orphan audio path available for retry: surface a Retry button that re-attempts the failed append / setTranscript step; audio is not lost on failure
Make error state conform to LocalizedError conventions (errorDescription, not debugDescription)
acceptance_criteria: A failed append (disk full / empty URL / permission denied) shows a clear message naming the failure and the saved file location
The user can retry the failed persistence step without losing the original .m4a file
No bare catch { } blocks in ListViewModel.finishRecording
